skill.displayName: FireRed Image Edit – Open Source AI Image Editing Model for High Fidelity Edits – CLI-powered
skill.summary: FireRed image editor — edit or generate images with high fidelity using FireRed open-source model

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of firered-image-edit-cli-skill.
- Allows editing or generating images with high fidelity using the FireRed open-source model via the weshop CLI.
- Requires installation of weshop-cli and setting of the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports up to 3 reference images and various aspect ratios.
- Provides secure API key usage instructions.
